liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Music Never Stopped** (2 reviews): Reviewer highlights that this song was on fire, typical of many 1978 performances; Reviewer urges listeners to wait until they hear The Music Never Stopped and Around & Around [12][15]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Reviewer describes the extended jam as a meltdown that makes listeners want to dance; Reviewer calls this a unique and passionate version, the only reason one might need the show [9][20]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Reviewer praises the Jerry, Bob, and Donna harmonies on this track as pretty [19]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Jerry’s guitar playing starts to rip during this song and continues throughout the night [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-07-07.mtx.octopusrider.98917.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd78-07-07.sbd.jerugim.293.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 170 min; rated 4.31/5 by 32 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer found instrument timbre and vocal depth improved after using Realplayer Plus EQ enhancement; Known flaw exists in the recording, specifically a dropout at 10:14 on disc three track two [2][17]
- **gd1978-07-07.sbd.jerugim.tetzeli.fix-293.33817.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 169 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [4]
- **gd1978-07-07.157698.aud.hicks-fong.flac2448**: audience recording; 22 songs; 164 min [7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes one track is missing from the recording, though the show remains in their top ten [13]
- Reviewer recalls seeing Bill Walton near the stage during the show, possibly on the rug [14]
- Crowd response to the opening lyric of Not Fade Away brought back goosebumps for the reviewer [14]
- Ranked among top Dead shows, alongside the next night and the May 8, 1977 Cornell performance [9]
- Reviewer calls it their all-time favorite show and the best Not Fade Away they have heard [11]
- Contrasts 1977 perfection with 1978 pure rock and roll energy, citing this as a favorite run [11]
- Scarlet Begonias into Fire On The Mountain is ranked second only to the May 8, 1977 performance [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-07-07.mtx.octopusrider.98917.flac16**: transferred by OctopusRider; source: SHNID 293 + SHIND 82931 + SHNID 91793 [1]. Also: The soundboard source is not stereo; one channel is missing and spread over both channels [1]
- **gd78-07-07.sbd.jerugim.293.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Recording lineage includes SBD to MR, then DAT, CD, and SHN conversion by Adam Jerugim [2]
- **gd1978-07-07.sbd.jerugim.tetzeli.fix-293.33817.shnf**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: SBD> MR> PCM > DAT; DAT> CD> EAC> SHN [4]. Also: Bill Tetzeli fixed overlap between CDs 2 and 3 using Cool Edit 2000 for seamless playback [4]
- **gd1978-07-07.157698.aud.hicks-fong.flac2448**: taped by concert recording by John Hicks & Dennis Fong.; transferred by Transferred by Andrew F. 08/2022; source: Unknown mics & deck (up front) > Maxell XLII's [7]. Also: ID-91793 patches were applied to Candyman, Tennessee Jed, and Space to improve the mix [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by www.notreble.com: [Grateful Dead Set Gives Classic 1978 Show an Official Release – No Treble](https://www.notreble.com/buzz/2016/05/17/grateful-dead-set-gives-classic-1978-show-an-official-release/) [22]
- Poster by JamBase: [July 1978: The Complete Recordings](https://www.jambase.com/contest/july-1978-complete-recordings) [23]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead Productions: [Grateful Dead Shirt T Shirt Red Rocks Colorado July 1978 7/7/78 Space SYF GDP L | #1869179784](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-shirt-shirt-red-rocks-1869179784) [24]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 7/7/78 Red Rocks Amphitheatre, Morrison, C… | Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27064072020/) [25]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27064072020/) [26]
